Git checks out every folder in this repository, so every file is written to your folder. In a partial clone, the files are downloaded first, which can take a while for a large project. Your commits and branches do not change.
column2: Git 会检出此仓库中的每个文件夹，因此每个文件都会写入你的文件夹。在部分克隆中，文件会先被下载，大型项目可能需要一些时间。你的提交和分支不会改变。

column1: NiceGit moves things back to where they were before. It refuses if the branch has moved since, so newer work is never lost.
column2: NiceGit 会将内容恢复到之前的状态。如果此后分支已移动，它会拒绝执行，因此不会丢失较新的工作。

column1: NiceGit puts back what the undo reversed. It refuses if the branch has moved since.
column2: NiceGit 会重新应用被撤销的内容。如果此后分支已移动，它会拒绝执行。

column1: Show the steps Undo will step back through
column2: 显示撤销将回退经过的步骤

column1: Choose what Fetch and Pull does
column2: 选择“获取和拉取”的操作

column1: Fetch, then merge the upstream's commits into the current branch
column2: 先获取，然后将上游的提交合并到当前分支

column1: Fetch, then replay the current branch's commits onto the upstream
column2: 先获取，然后将当前分支的提交变基到上游之上

column1: Save or close the file you are editing first.
column2: 请先保存或关闭正在编辑的文件。

column1: Hide the terminal (Ctrl-`); its shells keep running
column2: 隐藏终端 (Ctrl-`)；其中的 shell 会继续运行

column1: A fast Git client that keeps your work safe.
column2: 一个快速的 Git 客户端，让你的工作安全无忧。

column1: Or drag a folder onto this window.
column2: 或将文件夹拖到此窗口。

column1: Git was not found. Install Git, then restart NiceGit.
column2: 未找到 Git。请安装 Git，然后重新启动 NiceGit。

column1: A fast Git client for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
column2: 适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的快速 Git 客户端。

column1: Ctrl/Cmd-O to open · Shift-Ctrl/Cmd-P for commands
column2: Ctrl/Cmd-O 打开 · Shift-Ctrl/Cmd-P 命令

column1: Fetch, then choose whether to merge the remote's commits or rebase onto them
column2: 先获取，然后选择合并远程提交还是变基到其上

column1: Apply the stash's changes on top of your changes, and keep your changes
column2: 将贮藏的更改应用到你的更改之上，并保留你的更改

column1: Make the same commit again with Git hooks skipped
column2: 跳过 Git 钩子，重新执行同一次提交

column1: Applied the stash on top of your changes and removed it.
column2: 已将贮藏应用到你的更改之上，并将其删除。

column1: Applied the stash on top of your changes.
column2: 已将贮藏应用到你的更改之上。

column1: Applied the stash's unstaged changes on top of yours. It also saved staged changes, which were not applied, so the stash is kept.
column2: 已将贮藏中未暂存的更改应用到你的更改之上。已暂存的更改未被应用，但已一并保存，因此保留该贮藏。

column1: Remotes are fetched automatically; change how often in Settings.
column2: 远程仓库会自动获取；可在设置中更改频率。

column1: Rebase stopped to edit a commit: stage your changes, then Continue.
column2: 变基已停止以编辑提交：请暂存你的更改，然后继续。

column1: A {operation} is in progress. Continue when ready, or abort to return to where you started.
column2: {operation} 正在进行。准备好后继续，或中止以返回起点。

column1: A {operation} stopped with {count} conflicted file(s). Resolve each one, then continue.
column2: {operation} 因 {count} 个冲突文件而停止。请逐一解决后继续。

column1: Git returns the branch and files to the state before it started. Resolutions you made are lost.
column2: Git 会将分支和文件恢复到开始之前的状态。你所做的冲突解决将会丢失。

column1: Take one side of every conflicted file
column2: 对每个冲突文件采用其中一方
二分查找：测试 {hash} 并标记它{steps}

column1: Bisecting: mark a good and a bad commit to begin.
column2: 二分查找：请标记一个好提交和一个坏提交以开始。

column1: Press − beside a line to unstage it, or click and drag over lines to choose several.
column2: 点击行旁的 − 可取消暂存该行，或点击并拖动以选择多行。

column1: Press + beside a line to stage it, or click and drag over lines to choose several.
column2: 点击行旁的 + 可暂存该行，或点击并拖动以选择多行。

column1: Switch to Unified to {verb} single lines.
A new or deleted file has only one side, so it is shown in one column
column2: 新增或删除的文件只有一侧，因此以单列显示

column1: Widen the diff panel to show changes side by side
column2: 加宽差异面板以并排显示更改

column1: Show changed words merged into each line
column2: 在每行中合并显示更改的词语

column1: How many unchanged lines to show around each change
column2: 每处更改前后显示的未更改行数
在 NiceGit 中编辑此文件

column1: {lines} in {path} go back to their staged version.
column2: {path} 中的{lines}将恢复为已暂存的版本。

column1: {what} You can undo this from the Changes panel until the file changes again.
column2: {what} 在文件再次更改之前，可在“更改”面板中撤销此操作。

column1: Save or close the file you are editing before changing the repository.
column2: 在更改仓库之前，请先保存或关闭正在编辑的文件。
在 HEAD 处新建分支

column1: Its upstream branch no longer exists on the remote
column2: 其上游分支已不在远程仓库中
已在另一个工作树中检出

column1: Checked out {path} at its recorded commit.
column2: 已将 {path} 检出到其记录的提交。

column1: The tag is removed from {remote} for everyone who uses it, while it still matches your local tag. Your local tag is kept.
column2: 只要该标签仍与本地标签一致，它就会从 {remote} 中为所有使用者删除。本地标签会保留。

column1: The tag is removed from this repository only, not from remotes.
column2: 标签仅从此仓库中删除，不会从远程仓库删除。

column1: The current branch cannot be selected for deletion.
column2: 无法选择当前分支进行删除。

column1: Not merged into {branch}: {names}. Those hold commits found on no other branch, so they are deleted only while each still points to the tip shown.
column2: 未合并到 {branch}：{names}。这些分支含有其他分支上没有的提交，因此只有在它们仍指向所显示的末端时才会删除。

column1: Undo restores them at their tips until you take another undoable action.
column2: 撤销会将它们恢复到原先的末端，直到你进行另一次可撤销的操作为止。

column1: Replaces the remote branch with yours, if no one else has pushed since you last fetched
column2: 如果自你上次获取以来没有其他人推送，则用你的分支替换远程分支。

column1: Updates {remote}/{name} to {tip} ({subject}). Only this branch is pushed; tags are not.
column2: 将 {remote}/{name} 更新为 {tip}（{subject}）。仅推送此分支，不推送标签。

column1: The branch is removed from {remote} for everyone who uses it, while it still points to {tip}. Local branches are not changed.
column2: 只要该分支仍指向 {tip}，它就会从 {remote} 中为所有使用者删除。本地分支不会改变。

column1: {branch} tracks it; its upstream will be gone.
column2: {branch} 正在跟踪它；其上游将会消失。

column1: {branches} track it; their upstreams will be gone.
column2: {branches} 正在跟踪它；它们的上游将会消失。

column1: This branch is merged into the current branch, so no commits are lost.
column2: 此分支已合并到当前分支，因此不会丢失任何提交。

column1: This branch has commits that are not in the current branch, so Git will refuse to delete it. Merge it first, or use Clean Up Branches to delete unmerged branches. Its tip is {tip}.
column2: 此分支有不在当前分支上的提交，因此 Git 会拒绝删除。请先合并它，或使用“清理分支”删除未合并的分支。其末端为 {tip}。

column1: The current branch is always shown.
Set an upstream branch before force pushing.
column2: 强制推送前请先设置上游分支。

column1: Your branch's commits are replayed on top of the other branch. Conflicts stop the rebase for you to resolve or abort.
column2: 当前分支的提交会被重新应用到另一分支之上。遇到冲突时变基会暂停，供你解决或中止。

column1: Git merges the branch's commits into your current branch. Conflicts stop the merge for you to resolve or abort.
column2: Git 会将该分支的提交合并到当前分支。遇到冲突时合并会暂停，供你解决或中止。

column1: Removed the empty gpg.format setting from {file}.
column2: 已从 {file} 中删除空的 gpg.format 设置。

column1: Could not remove the gpg.format setting.
column2: 无法删除 gpg.format 设置。

column1: Your Git settings ({file}) have an empty gpg.format, which Git rejects whenever it signs a commit or checks a signature. Removing it changes nothing else: Git then uses its default signing format.
column2: 你的 Git 设置（{file}）中有一个空的 gpg.format，Git 在签名提交或检查签名时都会拒绝它。删除它不会改变其他任何内容：Git 将使用其默认签名格式。

column1: Remove the empty gpg.format from {file}. Git rejects it whenever it signs a commit or checks a signature.
column2: 从 {file} 中删除空的 gpg.format。Git 在签名提交或检查签名时都会拒绝它。
